verdict.rationale: Asana ships its own AI agents (AI Teammates, AI Studio), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Asana's official MCP server, which external AI clients such as Claude and ChatGPT connect to. That is the server role, not Asana consuming third-party MCP servers. The integration-directory line about powering AI workflows with context from other apps does not mention MCP, so it is at most adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
